name: Rob Crain
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: Attorney Rob Crain is a partner at Crain Brogdon, LLP, a Dallas, Texas, based law firm, where he provides comprehensive legal representation to individuals and families facing complicated civil matters. With more than three decades of experience, Mr. Crain focuses his practice on plaintiffs' personal injury law, advocating for individuals who have suffered catastrophic injuries or wrongful death. His extensive case history spans motor vehicle and trucking accidents, construction mishaps, premises liability, and traumatic brain injuries. Additionally, he handles highly sensitive matters involving sexual abuse, product and medical device defects, and business litigation.

Dedicated to achieving meaningful results for his clients, Mr. Crain has established a reputation for strategic advocacy and ethical practice. His commitment to the legal profession is reflected in his peer recognition, including an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest distinction for legal ability and ethical standards.

Mr. Crain is an active leader within the Texas legal community, holding numerous high-profile leadership roles. He has served as president of the Dallas Bar Association and as a director for the State Bar of Texas from 2018 to 2021. He is also a long-standing member of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association board of directors, a role he has held since 2001.

Academically accomplished, Mr. Crain earned his Bachelor of Arts with high honors from The University of Texas at Austin in 1990. He then obtained his Juris Doctor from The University of Texas at Austin School of Law in 1994. He was admitted to the State Bar of Texas that same year.

Mr. Crain maintains active memberships with the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association and the American Association for Justice. He is further recognized as a sustaining life fellow of the Dallas Bar Foundation and a life fellow of the Texas Bar Foundation.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
